The level of elaboration is thorough and rich, covering various aspects of the negotiation process, from pre-negotiation intelligence to integration and ongoing harmony maintenance.

The emphasis on respect for hierarchy, formal communication protocols, and adaptability to local customs and practices reflects a high level of cultural sensitivity, acknowledging the importance of these factors in achieving successful cross-border partnerships.
